parameters.name: AutoRenew
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. This parameter is valid only when \`payType\` is set to \`PrePaid\`. The default value is false.

parameters.name: BillingInstanceIds
parameters.description: A list of billing instance IDs to modify. Separate multiple IDs with commas.

parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description: The subscription duration. This parameter is valid only when \`payType\` is set to \`PrePaid\`.

parameters.name: PricingCycle
parameters.description:
The unit of the subscription duration:

- Month

- Year

This parameter is valid only when \`payType\` is set to \`PrePaid\`.
